summary: Deploy new Saleor version with state-only migration to preserve the note column during overlap, retire the old version, then drop the note column via a contract SQL stage. The old version continues writing notes; the new version ignores the field, ensuring no write failures or data loss.
write_consistency: Old version writes note values through its Django model and GraphQL APIs; new version has no note field and thus never references the column. During the overlap phase, the note column remains and accumulates all writes from the old version. After retire_old, the column is safely removed with no further writes.
revision_notes: No revision; plan constructed per staged_rollout with state_only deploy and post-retire_old column removal.

stages.description: Retire old Saleor version; after this stage, only the new version serves traffic.
Remove the note column from account_user table.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note
